Source image full visual description. Treat this as the source of truth for layer reconstruction: A promotional poster featuring a Black male model in profile looking upwards and to the left, smiling with diamond grills on his teeth. He wears black rectangular sunglasses, a silver diamond stud earring, a silver open-ear earphone, and a textured black leather jacket with metallic buttons. His hair is styled in dreadlocks and he has a full beard. The lighting is dramatic, with a strong neon green glow and bokeh effect coming from the left, casting bright green rim light on his face and jacket, while the right side fades into dark shadow. Thin, transparent white concentric elliptical lines radiate around his ear. The top left corner has a white 'oraimo' logo. The bottom quarter of the image is a solid white rectangular block containing black text 'ORAIMO Space Arc', 'OPEN SOUND BY BURNA BOY', a neon green scribble graphic, and on the right side, an open black and silver charging case displaying a pair of silver and black open-ear earphones. The overall image quality is high-resolution, photorealistic, and highly polished.
Reference layer split mode. Use the input image as the only visual source. Output exactly the requested layer from the provided reference image. Layers should recompose in this order: background, subject/product, decorations, text/logo.

Output only this one design layer. Do not invent new visual assets. Do not output a contact sheet, asset pack, grid, collage, full poster, or unrelated object. For text/logo layer, visible text and logo shapes are allowed. For background layer, a full-frame background plate is allowed. For other layers, keep real alpha outside the extracted/recreated content. Never render a checkerboard, gray-white grid, transparency preview canvas, or fake transparency pattern.

透明素材文生模板

连接关系：透明素材提示词生成器 -> GPT-Image-2 Alpha -> 透明PNG保存预览。
必须使用 Alpha 节点输出 image_urls，再接保存节点，才能保存真实 alpha 透明 PNG。

参数建议：
1. scene_preset 选择要生成的类别。
2. 稳定测试先用 规则预设(不调用LLM)；需要自动拆分素材名时再用 自动规划(LLM)。
3. save_path 可以填写绝对路径

提示词示例：
通用透明素材：生成一个蓝紫科技风的AI魔法水晶球，透明PNG，主体居中，干净边缘，不要背景。
UI图标套装：AI绘图工具图标套装，包含生成、编辑、上传、下载、收藏、设置，统一蓝紫科技风。
人物/IP贴纸：原创圆形表情贴纸，包含开心、疑问、点赞、比心，统一可爱3D风，不要真人。
游戏道具素材：奇幻RPG道具，包含金币、宝箱、生命药水、魔法水晶，统一高亮3D图标风。
节日活动素材：双11电商活动透明素材，礼盒、优惠券底板、倒计时牌、促销爆炸贴，红金喜庆风。
参考图分层拆图：先完整描述参考图，再按图层拆出文字/Logo、主体/人物/产品、背景、装饰元素。尽量保持原图主体造型、材质纹理、光影方向、颜色关系和画质细节，只拆图中真实存在的内容，不新增素材。
